d17.pair_0.template: Do these two records describe one {noun} or two?
d17.pair_0.state_kind: two records of one type (person, company or publication) from two systems, as JSON or as prose 'Record from system A. field: value; ...'; the matching policy is in the criteria
d17.pair_0.answer_meaning: one_entity iff the matching policy in the criteria, applied in order to THESE TWO records, says they are one {noun}: the identifier when both carry it, else the date both carry and then the names under clause 3's allowances; two_entities otherwise. When neither the identifier nor the date appears in both records the target is soft [0.5, 0.5]. {noun} is the record type. A rewording must keep the question about whether the two records are the same entity under the stated policy, not about similarity
